title: Cody Poskin leads from start to finish to win the Kodiak 100
claims: Cody Poskin won the 2026 Kodiak 100-mile race in 16:46:21 and Nichole Abma won the women's race in 20:43:40.
Jose Angel Fernandez Jimenez won the 2026 100K in 8:33:09, with Gavin Prior second in 8:35:40 and Stephen Kersh third in 8:59:04; Lotti Brinks won the women's 100K in 10:15:44.
Cole Campbell won the 2026 50K in 3:20:42 and Anna Gibson won the women's 50K in 3:59:13.
The article says UTMB's official results give the 100M as 161.1 km with 4,877 m of gain and the 100K as 101.1 km with 3,143 m.

verification.note: 2026-11-09 读取第三方赛后报道；其自述成绩来自 UTMB Index 官方结果页，本页仍按 B 层处理。
